items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I once went to see Johnny Simmens. I remember when Johnny Simmens' house was lost in the beauty of these trees and bushes.

ctx.x: when it was practically deserted. It was so nice and tranquil. Now, the (?) Grill is gone, and they're digging underneath for parking space. And in Holland, where it was a pleasure and an achievement to bicycle from Rotterdam to Amsterdam, because it's flat... I mean, you can shoot a bullet and it runs a mile! Now, there's no such thing of people doing that. They have highways going PSHWOO, full of people, cars are racing, you know...

It's different. It's unbelievable. I once went to see Johnny Simmens. I remember when Johnny Simmens' house was lost in the beauty of these trees and bushes. Now you can't get to his house where the cars park double-parked!
The lake... I remember I used to swim in the lake. I almost drowned there, but I came out of it...
